channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Sanders proposes four-day workweek alongside AI adoption
item.description: Bernie Sanders and Mark Takano propose using AI productivity gains to achieve a 32-hour workweek without reducing pay or benefits.

item.title: Companies direct tariff refunds toward worker retirement
item.description: Williams Sonoma and TJX plan to return millions in tariff refunds to employees via 401(k) contributions and bonuses.

item.title: Manufacturing AI startup CADDi valued at $1.2 billion
item.description: The company aims to overcome what it calls the physical bottleneck limiting AI's impact on manufacturing.

item.title: Pro sports face shrinkflation as NFL viewing costs rise 28.6% since 2015
item.description: Watching football this season costs more while delivering less, according to new figures.
